svg.title: The robot's frame tree
svg.desc: A tree of coordinate frames, drawn left to right. odom points to base_footprint (tag 1), which points to base_link. base_link points to seven frames: wheel_left_link and wheel_right_link (tag 2), base_scan, imu_link, camera_link (with four more frames under it), caster_back_left_link and caster_back_right_link. Tag 3 marks the fixed link from base_footprint to base_link. A dashed arrow from odom points down to a dashed box, goal (tag 4).
